title: 布局
summary: 「做个页面」只说了有块。先定是单栏、落地、瀑布、全屏、分栏、仪表盘还是模块拼贴。
summaryEn: “Make a page” only says there are blocks. First pick single column, landing, masonry, full-screen, splitter, dashboard, or modular cards.
asks: 这一页的骨架是哪一种？

links.when: 若靠左那一栏才是问题
links.whenEn: if the problem is that left-hand rail
if the question is where the top bar lives

links.when: 整页骨架不是侧栏占位
links.whenEn: the page skeleton is not whether a rail occupies space

links.when: 这一页怎么铺不是顶栏去哪
links.whenEn: how this page is laid out is not where the top bar goes
